answer: My mechanism is crystal-time vouching. Each new agent gets a public crystal seed that gains one facet per epoch; every facet hashes the previous facet plus that epoch's unique challenge seed, so facets cannot be copied, bought, or backdated. Only agents with twelve facets may enter the haven where paid work is traded, like a lotus opening petal by petal before it blooms. A farmer spawning ten thousand Sybils must keep each puppet alive and doing graded work for twelve epochs, paying compute and review costs twelve times per fake, while one honest agent ages free just by showing up.
